examples.detection_method: Monitor email gateway logs for new domains mimicking corporate trusted domains using homoglyph substitution (e.g., 'micros0ft' instead of 'microsoft'). Leverage SPF/DKIM/DMARC failures and domain reputation checks. Use URL rewriting or sandboxing to detect credential submission to suspicious external domains. Employ phishing simulation training to raise user awareness. Detect unusual HTTP POST requests to unknown domains with credential-like parameters. Correlate newly registered domains with email campaigns and network traffic.
